note: Parenti et al. delineate 18 individuals with MAU2 variants and identify microcephaly and short stature as primary consistent features of the new CdLS subtype.

evidence.text: Parenti et al. characterize 18 individuals carrying 15 heterozygous MAU2 variants, finding that microcephaly and short stature represent major, consistent clinical features across the spectrum.

source.title: Pathogenic variants in the cohesin loader subunit MAU2 lead to a new Cornelia de Lange Syndrome subtype
source.quote: Affected individuals display a wide range of phenotypes, from classic CdLS to milder presentations, with short stature and microcephaly as consistent features.

evidence.text: Parenti et al. report that MAU2 variants give rise to a distinct CdLS subtype primarily characterized by short stature and microcephaly, confirmed also in a Mau2 knockout mouse model.
